nodes.summary: Let $k$ be a field, $N$ a non-unital associative $k$-algebra and $y_1, \dots, y_r \in N$. The Golod group of $y$ is the subgroup of the group of units of the unitization $k \oplus N$ generated by the units that are equal to $1 + y_i$ for some $i$. When every $1 + y_i$ is invertible (for example when $N$ is nil), this is the subgroup $\langle 1 + y_1, \dots, 1 + y_r \rangle$ of the adjoint group $1 + N$.

conditional.label: conditionally proved

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.
